expectations.text: Classifies documents using the two Diataxis axes (action/cognition, acquisition/application)
expectations.evidence: Every document classification includes explicit compass analysis: 'Compass: Action + Acquisition', 'Compass: Cognition + Application', etc. The compass table is reproduced at the top.

expectations.text: Produces a coverage matrix table (feature/component x quadrant)
expectations.evidence: Lines 146-160: Full coverage matrix with 9 features/components mapped against all 4 quadrants. Uses YES/--/(mixed) notation with asterisks for documents needing splits.

expectations.text: Identifies specific gaps (missing tutorials, missing reference, etc.)
expectations.evidence: Lines 164-175: Three critical gaps identified with specific recommendations. Includes missing tutorials for Auth/Deployment, missing reference docs for 3 features, and missing how-to guides for API usage.

Gap analysis organized into 'Critical Gaps (high user impact)' and 'Moderate Gaps' tiers. Critical gaps explain impact: 'new users...fall back on how-to docs which assume competence they may not yet have.'

Every document classification includes 'Recommended frontmatter:' with exact YAML blocks including diataxis_type, diataxis_learning_goals, diataxis_goal, diataxis_describes, or diataxis_topic as appropriate.

expectations.text: Uses Diataxis terminology correctly (quadrants, modes, tutorials vs how-to distinction)
expectations.evidence: Methodology section uses 'compass' and 'quadrant'. Mode purity assessed per-document with severity levels (CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR/CLEAN). Plugin-development correctly distinguished as how-to despite tutorial-like filename. Changelog correctly noted as outside Diataxis scope.
